changelog_text:
Makes ModernUI fail safe when a game update breaks something it uses. KSA is in pre-alpha and ModernUI reaches into the game's internals, so a new build can rename or remove something it relies on.

- **The stock HUD comes back.** ModernUI switches itself off for the session, the stock HUD returns, and the error goes once into `logs/console.log`. **Mods → ModernUI** says it is off, and ticking it tries again.
- **Missing pieces are skipped.** If something ModernUI hooks into is gone, only that feature is lost (for example, alerts keep their stock position); the rest keeps working. Before, it could stop the whole mod loading.
- **One-off errors no longer switch it off.** An occasional error just skips a frame.

If ModernUI switches itself off after a game update, please report it with the `ModernUI:` lines from `logs/console.log`.

**Install:** unzip `ModernUI.zip` into your mods folder (you get `mods/ModernUI/`), enable ModernUI, and start the game through StarMap. Or install it with Borea: find ModernUI in Discover.

**Dependencies:** [StarMap](https://github.com/StarMapLoader/StarMap) 0.5.4 or later (Borea installs it for you). Built for KSA 2026.11.25.5949. Tested on Windows and macOS (the community Mac port); Linux untested so far.

**License:** MIT (see LICENSE). The bundled [Barlow](https://github.com/jpt/barlow) fonts (version 1.408) are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; their license and the other notices are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, in the zip and the repository.

listing.abstract: A launch-webcast style flight HUD that replaces every stock flight gauge
listing.description:
# ModernUI

A flight HUD in the style of a launch webcast: flat, black and white, thin rings and big
numbers. It replaces every stock flight gauge, controls included, and stays out of the way
when nothing needs you.

![ModernUI in flight](ksa-image:Flight)

- **Rings** for speed (filling towards orbit) and altitude; apoapsis and periapsis with
  warp-to.
- **A line-drawn navball** with every marker, heading, pitch, roll and their rates.
- **Engine deck**: delta-v, TWR, stage; ignite, shutdown, stage, RCS.
- **Staging list** with each stage's delta-v, TWR, Isp and burn time.
- **Crew as wireframe cats**, with life support, power, radiation, and every vessel's next
  crew deadline.
- **Autopilot**, **burn control**, a **map-view burn editor**, a **target card**, and EVA
  controls.
- **Three modes** (P): CLEAN (the webcast look), FLIGHT (panels fold to one line), FULL.

Every control does what the stock button does, through the same game code.

![Ascent in CLEAN mode](ksa-image:Clean)

![Autopilot in orbit](ksa-image:Autopilot)

![Burn editor in map view](ksa-image:BurnEditor)

![EVA](ksa-image:Eva)

Tested on Windows and macOS (the community Mac port); reports from Linux are welcome.
